title: Admin Action Event
description: Represents an immutable log entry of a destructive or approval action performed by an Admin or TC in the platform.

log_id.description: Unique identifier for the action log

action_type.description: The category of the admin action

actor_id.description: User ID of the Admin/TC performing the action

target_entity_id.description: ID of the User, Partner, Document, or Transaction affected

reason_text.description: Mandatory explanation provided by the admin for rejections or overrides
